#!/bin/bash
#==============================================================================
# 蜂窝网络日志分析脚本
# 功能：分析cellular_log_for_AI.log日志，根据规则输出诊断结论和建议措施
#==============================================================================

# 默认日志文件路径
LOG_FILE="${1:-/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/cellular_log_for_AI.log}"

# 输出报告目录配置
OUTPUT_DIR="/home/x25026/AIinDevice"
OUTPUT_FILENAME="cellular_diagnosis_result_for_AI.md"

#==============================================================================
# 颜色定义
#==============================================================================
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
CYAN='\033[0;36m'
NC='\033[0m' # No Color

#==============================================================================
# 打印分隔线
#==============================================================================
print_separator() {
    echo "================================================================================"
}

print_minor_separator() {
    echo "--------------------------------------------------------------------------------"
}

#==============================================================================
# 打印诊断结论框 - 标题部分
#==============================================================================
print_diagnosis_title() {
    local title="$1"
    local color="$2"
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${color}┏━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┓${NC}"
    echo -e "  ${color}┃${NC}  ${color}${title}${NC}"
    echo -e "  ${color}┗━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━┛${NC}"
    echo ""
}

#==============================================================================
# 打印诊断结论框 - 底部分隔
#==============================================================================
print_diagnosis_footer() {
    echo ""
    echo -e "  ${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
}

#==============================================================================
# 检查日志文件是否存在
#==============================================================================
check_log_file() {
    if [ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]; then
        echo -e "${RED}Error: Log file not found: $LOG_FILE${NC}"
        exit 1
    fi
}

#==============================================================================
# 提取各部分日志的CONCLUSION结果
#==============================================================================
extract_conclusions() {
    # 定义日志部分名称数组
    LOG_PARTS=("module_name.log" "sim_status.log" "airplane_status.log" 
               "network_registration_status.log" "ps_status.log" "quectel_cm.log" 
               "ifconfig.log" "public_network_status.log" "acmp_status.log")
    
    # 初始化结果数组
    declare -g -A RESULTS
    
    for part in "${LOG_PARTS[@]}"; do
        # 提取该部分日志内容
        local start_marker="SOURCE_FILE: $part"
        local end_marker="END_OF_FILE: $part"
        
        # 提取该部分的CONCLUSION行
        local section_content=$(sed -n "/$start_marker/,/$end_marker/p" "$LOG_FILE")
        local conclusion_line=$(echo "$section_content" | grep "\[CONCLUSION\]:")
        
        if [ -n "$conclusion_line" ]; then
            if echo "$conclusion_line" | grep -q "\[PASS\]"; then
                RESULTS["$part"]="PASS"
            elif echo "$conclusion_line" | grep -q "\[FAIL\]"; then
                RESULTS["$part"]="FAIL"
            else
                RESULTS["$part"]="UNKNOWN"
            fi
        else
            RESULTS["$part"]="NOT_FOUND"
        fi
    done
}

#==============================================================================
# 打印日志分析摘要
#==============================================================================
print_summary() {
    echo ""
    print_separator
    echo -e "${CYAN}                    Cellular Network Log Analysis Report${NC}"
    print_separator
    echo ""
    echo -e "${BLUE}【Log Section Status】${NC}"
    print_minor_separator
    
    # 定义各部分的易读名称（不包含尾部空格，由printf格式化对齐）
    declare -A PART_NAMES
    PART_NAMES["module_name.log"]="5G Module Initialization"
    PART_NAMES["sim_status.log"]="SIM Card Status"
    PART_NAMES["airplane_status.log"]="Mobile Data Switch"
    PART_NAMES["network_registration_status.log"]="Mobile Network Registration"
    PART_NAMES["ps_status.log"]="PS Domain Registration"
    PART_NAMES["quectel_cm.log"]="Data_call Status"
    PART_NAMES["ifconfig.log"]="IPv4 Bearer Establishment"
    PART_NAMES["public_network_status.log"]="Public Network Accessibility"
    PART_NAMES["acmp_status.log"]="ACMP Server Connectivity"
    
    local index=1
    for part in "module_name.log" "sim_status.log" "airplane_status.log" \
                "network_registration_status.log" "ps_status.log" "quectel_cm.log" \
                "ifconfig.log" "public_network_status.log" "acmp_status.log"; do
        local status="${RESULTS[$part]}"
        local display_name="${PART_NAMES[$part]}"
        local status_color=""
        if [ "$status" = "PASS" ]; then
            status_color="${GREEN}PASS${NC}"
        elif [ "$status" = "FAIL" ]; then
            status_color="${RED}FAIL${NC}"
        else
            status_color="${YELLOW}$status${NC}"
        fi
        printf "Section %d: %-28s Status: %b\n" "$index" "$display_name" "$status_color"
        ((index++))
    done
    
    print_minor_separator
    echo ""
}

#==============================================================================
# 规则8的详细分析函数
# 当满足规则8的条件时，需要进一步分析详细拒绝码等信息
#==============================================================================
analyze_rule8() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}【Detailed Analysis - Network Registration Status】${NC}"
    print_minor_separator
    
    # 读取整个日志内容 (统一去除Windows换行符\r)
    local log_content=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE")
    
    # 提取所有+CEREG:行的第二个参数
    local cereg_values=$(echo "$log_content" | grep "+CEREG:" | sed 's/.*+CEREG:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\),\([0-9]*\).*/\2/')
    
    # 提取IMSI (第一个仅包含数字且长度大于10的行)
    local imsi=$(echo "$log_content" | grep -E "^[0-9]{10,}$" | head -1)
    
    # 提取拒绝码
    local emm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "emm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    local esm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "esm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    local fivegmm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "5gmm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    
    # 提取CSQ值
    local csq_value=$(echo "$log_content" | grep "+CSQ:" | tail -1 | sed 's/.*+CSQ:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
    
    # 提取QENG servingcell信息
    local qeng_info=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QENG:.*servingcell' | tail -1)
    local qeng_status=$(echo "$qeng_info" | sed 's/.*"servingcell","\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
    
    # 提取QENG中的MCC和MNC (格式: +QENG: "servingcell","LIMSRV","WCDMA",460,01,...)
    local qeng_mcc=""
    local qeng_mnc=""
    if [ -n "$qeng_info" ]; then
        qeng_mcc=$(echo "$qeng_info" | awk -F',' '{print $4}' | tr -d ' ')
        qeng_mnc=$(echo "$qeng_info" | awk -F',' '{print $5}' | tr -d ' ')
    fi
    local qeng_mccmnc="${qeng_mcc}${qeng_mnc}"
    
    # 从IMSI提取MCC/MNC前缀（与qeng_mccmnc长度相同）
    local imsi_mccmnc=""
    if [ -n "$imsi" ] && [ -n "$qeng_mccmnc" ]; then
        local mccmnc_len=${#qeng_mccmnc}
        imsi_mccmnc=${imsi:0:$mccmnc_len}
    fi
    
    # 提取网络模式配置
    local mode_pref=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNWPREFCFG: "mode_pref"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([A-Za-z0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    
    # 打印提取的信息
    echo " Key Information:"
    echo "  IMSI: ${imsi:-Not Found}"
    echo "  CSQ Value: ${csq_value:-Not Found}"
    echo "  EMM Reject Code: ${emm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  ESM Reject Code: ${esm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  5GMM Reject Code: ${fivegmm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  Network Mode: ${mode_pref:-Not Found}"
    echo "  Service Status: ${qeng_status:-Not Found}"
    echo "  Cell MCCMNC: ${qeng_mccmnc:-Not Found}"
    echo "  SIM MCCMNC: ${imsi_mccmnc:-Not Found}"
    echo ""
    
    # 设置默认值
    emm_cause=${emm_cause:-0}
    esm_cause=${esm_cause:-0}
    fivegmm_cause=${fivegmm_cause:-0}
    csq_value=${csq_value:-99}
    
    # 检查CEREG状态
    local cereg_has_1_or_5=false
    local cereg_all_not_1_or_5=true
    local cereg_all_0=true
    local cereg_all_2=true
    local cereg_all_3=true
    local cereg_all_4=true
    local cereg_is_0_or_2=false
    
    for val in $cereg_values; do
        if [ "$val" = "1" ] || [ "$val" = "5" ]; then
            cereg_has_1_or_5=true
            cereg_all_not_1_or_5=false
            cereg_all_0=false
            cereg_all_2=false
            cereg_all_3=false
            cereg_all_4=false
        else
            if [ "$val" = "0" ]; then
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
                cereg_is_0_or_2=true
            elif [ "$val" = "2" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
                cereg_is_0_or_2=true
            elif [ "$val" = "3" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_4=false
            elif [ "$val" = "4" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
            else
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
            fi
        fi
    done
    
    # 规则8-1: CEREG有1或5, 5gmm_cause不为0
    if [ "$cereg_has_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-1${NC} (4G Registered, 5G Reject Code but not affect business)"
        echo ""
        output_rule8_1
        return
    fi
    
    # 规则8-2: CEREG有1或5, 所有拒绝码为0
    if [ "$cereg_has_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-2${NC} (4G Registered, Network Status Fully Normal)"
        echo ""
        output_rule8_2
        return
    fi
    
    # 规则8-3到8-16: 检查EMM拒绝码
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$emm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        case "$emm_cause" in
            2)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-3${NC} (EMM Reject Code=2, IMSI Not Found)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_3 ;;
            3)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-4${NC} (EMM Reject Code=3, Illegal UE)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_4 ;;
            5)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-5${NC} (EMM Reject Code=5, IMEI Not Accepted)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_5 ;;
            6)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-6${NC} (EMM Reject Code=6, Illegal Mobile Device)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_6 ;;
            7)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-7${NC} (EMM Reject Code=7, EPS Service Not Allowed)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_7 ;;
            8)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-8${NC} (EMM Reject Code=8, All Mobile Services Forbidden)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_8 ;;
            11) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-9${NC} (EMM Reject Code=11, PLMN Not Allowed)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_9 ;;
            12) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-10${NC} (EMM Reject Code=12, TA Area Restricted)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_10 ;;
            13) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-11${NC} (EMM Reject Code=13, Roaming Not Allowed)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_11 ;;
            14) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-12${NC} (EMM Reject Code=14, EPS Service PLMN Not Covered)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_12 ;;
            15) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-13${NC} (EMM Reject Code=15, No Suitable Cell)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_13 ;;
                22) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-14${NC} (EMM Reject Code=22, Network Congestion)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_14 ;;
            42) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-15${NC} (EMM Reject Code=42, Network Severe Fault)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_15 ;;
            *)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-16${NC} (EMM Reject Code=${emm_cause}, Other Reject Reasons)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_16 "$emm_cause" ;;
        esac
        return
    fi
    
    # 规则8-17到8-25: 检查ESM拒绝码
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        case "$esm_cause" in
            27) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-17${NC} (ESM Reject Code=27, APN Name Error)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_17 ;;
            29) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-18${NC} (ESM Reject Code=29, APN Authentication Failed)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_18 ;;
            33) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-19${NC} (ESM Reject Code=33, Data Service Not Subscribed)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_19 ;;
            8)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-20${NC} (ESM Reject Code=8, Data Service Restricted)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_20 ;;
            28) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-21${NC} (ESM Reject Code=28, PDN Type Incorrect)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_21 ;;
            50) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-22${NC} (ESM Reject Code=50, Only Support IPv4)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_22 ;;
            51) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-23${NC} (ESM Reject Code=51, Only Support IPv6)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_23 ;;
            26) echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-24${NC} (ESM Reject Code=26, Network Resource Insufficient)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_24 ;;
            *)  echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-25${NC} (ESM Reject Code=${esm_cause}, Other PDN Reject Reasons)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_25 "$esm_cause" ;;
        esac
        return
    fi
    
    # 规则8-26: 无信号
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" = "99" ]; then
            if [ "$qeng_status" = "NOSERVICE" ] || [ "$qeng_status" = "SEARCH" ]; then
                echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-26${NC} (No Signal)"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_26
                return
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-27: 信号极弱
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" != "99" ] && [ "$csq_value" -lt 10 ]; then
            echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-27${NC} (Very Weak Signal, CSQ<10)"
            echo ""
            output_rule8_27
            return
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-28: 驻留到其他运营商小区，MCCMNC不匹配
    if [ "$cereg_is_0_or_2" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            if [ "$qeng_status" = "LIMSRV" ] && [ -n "$qeng_mccmnc" ] && [ -n "$imsi_mccmnc" ]; then
                if [ "$qeng_mccmnc" != "$imsi_mccmnc" ]; then
                    echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-28${NC} (Cell MCCMNC Mismatch: Cell=${qeng_mccmnc}, SIM=${imsi_mccmnc})"
                    echo ""
                    output_rule8_28
                    return
                fi
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-29: 网络模式不是AUTO
    if [ "$cereg_all_0" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            if [ -n "$mode_pref" ] && [ "$mode_pref" != "AUTO" ]; then
                echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-29${NC} (Network Mode Not AUTO: ${mode_pref})"
                echo ""
                output_rule8_29
                return
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-30: 长时间搜网
    if [ "$cereg_all_2" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null || [ "$csq_value" = "99" ]; then
            echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-30${NC} (Long Time Search Network Status)"
            echo ""
            output_rule8_30
            return
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-31: 网络拒绝注册
    if [ "$cereg_all_3" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-31${NC} (Network Reject Registration, No Specific Reason)"
        echo ""
        output_rule8_31
        return
    fi
    
    # Rule 8-32: Unknown status
    if [ "$cereg_all_4" = true ]; then
        echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-32${NC} (Unknown Registration Status)"
        echo ""
        output_rule8_32
        return
    fi
    
    # 规则8-33: 5G拒绝但4G也未注册
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${CYAN}Rule 8-33${NC} (5G Reject Code=${fivegmm_cause}, 4G Also Not Registered)"
        echo ""
        output_rule8_33 "$fivegmm_cause"
        return
    fi
    
    # Default output
    echo -e "Match Sub-Rule: ${YELLOW}Rule 8-Default${NC} (No Match Specific Sub-Rule)"
    echo ""
    output_rule8_default
}

#==============================================================================
# 规则8的全量输出函数（输出所有匹配的子规则，不筛选）
#==============================================================================
analyze_rule8_full_output() {
    echo -e "${BLUE}【Detailed Analysis - Network Registration Status】${NC}"
    print_minor_separator
    
    # 读取整个日志内容 (统一去除Windows换行符\r)
    local log_content=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE")
    
    # 提取所有+CEREG:行的第二个参数
    local cereg_values=$(echo "$log_content" | grep "+CEREG:" | sed 's/.*+CEREG:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\),\([0-9]*\).*/\2/')
    
    # 提取IMSI
    local imsi=$(echo "$log_content" | grep -E "^[0-9]{10,}$" | head -1)
    
    # 提取拒绝码
    local emm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "emm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    local esm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "esm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    local fivegmm_cause=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNETRC: "5gmm_cause"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    
    # 提取CSQ值
    local csq_value=$(echo "$log_content" | grep "+CSQ:" | tail -1 | sed 's/.*+CSQ:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
    
    # 提取QENG servingcell信息
    local qeng_info=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QENG:.*servingcell' | tail -1)
    local qeng_status=$(echo "$qeng_info" | sed 's/.*"servingcell","\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
    
    # 提取QENG中的MCC和MNC
    local qeng_mcc=""
    local qeng_mnc=""
    if [ -n "$qeng_info" ]; then
        qeng_mcc=$(echo "$qeng_info" | awk -F',' '{print $4}' | tr -d ' ')
        qeng_mnc=$(echo "$qeng_info" | awk -F',' '{print $5}' | tr -d ' ')
    fi
    local qeng_mccmnc="${qeng_mcc}${qeng_mnc}"
    
    # 从IMSI提取MCC/MNC前缀
    local imsi_mccmnc=""
    if [ -n "$imsi" ] && [ -n "$qeng_mccmnc" ]; then
        local mccmnc_len=${#qeng_mccmnc}
        imsi_mccmnc=${imsi:0:$mccmnc_len}
    fi
    
    # 提取网络模式配置
    local mode_pref=$(echo "$log_content" | grep '+QNWPREFCFG: "mode_pref"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*,\([A-Za-z0-9]*\)$/\1/')
    
    # 打印提取的信息
    echo " Key Information:"
    echo "  IMSI: ${imsi:-Not Found}"
    echo "  CSQ Value: ${csq_value:-Not Found}"
    echo "  EMM Reject Code: ${emm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  ESM Reject Code: ${esm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  5GMM Reject Code: ${fivegmm_cause:-0}"
    echo "  Network Mode: ${mode_pref:-Not Found}"
    echo "  Service Status: ${qeng_status:-Not Found}"
    echo "  Cell MCCMNC: ${qeng_mccmnc:-Not Found}"
    echo "  SIM MCCMNC: ${imsi_mccmnc:-Not Found}"
    echo ""
    
    # 设置默认值
    emm_cause=${emm_cause:-0}
    esm_cause=${esm_cause:-0}
    fivegmm_cause=${fivegmm_cause:-0}
    csq_value=${csq_value:-99}
    
    # 检查CEREG状态
    local cereg_has_1_or_5=false
    local cereg_all_not_1_or_5=true
    local cereg_all_0=true
    local cereg_all_2=true
    local cereg_all_3=true
    local cereg_all_4=true
    local cereg_is_0_or_2=false
    
    for val in $cereg_values; do
        if [ "$val" = "1" ] || [ "$val" = "5" ]; then
            cereg_has_1_or_5=true
            cereg_all_not_1_or_5=false
            cereg_all_0=false
            cereg_all_2=false
            cereg_all_3=false
            cereg_all_4=false
        else
            if [ "$val" = "0" ]; then
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
                cereg_is_0_or_2=true
            elif [ "$val" = "2" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
                cereg_is_0_or_2=true
            elif [ "$val" = "3" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_4=false
            elif [ "$val" = "4" ]; then
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
            else
                cereg_all_0=false
                cereg_all_2=false
                cereg_all_3=false
                cereg_all_4=false
            fi
        fi
    done
    
    local sub_match_count=0
    
    echo -e "${BLUE}【All Matched Sub-Rule Diagnostic Conclusion】${NC}"
    print_minor_separator
    echo ""
    
    # 规则8-1: CEREG有1或5, 5gmm_cause不为0
    if [ "$cereg_has_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-1 (4G Registered, 5G Reject Code but not affect business) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_1
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 规则8-2: CEREG有1或5, 所有拒绝码为0
    if [ "$cereg_has_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-2 (4G Registered, Network Status Fully Normal) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_2
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 规则8-3到8-16: 检查EMM拒绝码
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$emm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        case "$emm_cause" in
            2)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-3 (EMM Reject Code=2, IMSI Not Found) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_3 ;;
            3)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-4 (EMM Reject Code=3, Illegal UE) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_4 ;;
            5)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-5 (EMM Reject Code=5, IMEI Not Accepted) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_5 ;;
            6)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-6 (EMM Reject Code=6, Illegal Mobile Device) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_6 ;;
            7)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-7 (EMM Reject Code=7, EPS Service Not Allowed) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_7 ;;
            8)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-8 (EMM Reject Code=8, All Mobile Services Forbidden) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_8 ;;
            11) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-9 (EMM Reject Code=11, PLMN Not Allowed) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_9 ;;
            12) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-10 (EMM Reject Code=12, TA Area Restricted) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_10 ;;
            13) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-11 (EMM Reject Code=13, Roaming Not Allowed) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_11 ;;
            14) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-12 (EMM Reject Code=14, EPS Service PLMN Not Covered) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_12 ;;
            15) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-13 (EMM Reject Code=15, No Suitable Cell) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_13 ;;
            22) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-14 (EMM Reject Code=22, Network Congestion) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_14 ;;
            42) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-15 (EMM Reject Code=42, Network Severe Fault) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_15 ;;
            *)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-16 (EMM Reject Code=${emm_cause}, Other Reject Reasons) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_16 "$emm_cause" ;;
        esac
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # Rule 8-17 to 8-25: Check ESM reject codes
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        case "$esm_cause" in
            27) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-17 (ESM Reject Code=27, APN Name Error) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_17 ;;
            29) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-18 (ESM Reject Code=29, APN Authentication Failed) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_18 ;;
            33) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-19 (ESM Reject Code=33, Data Service Not Subscribed) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_19 ;;
            8)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-20 (ESM Reject Code=8, Data Service Restricted) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_20 ;;
            28) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-21 (ESM Reject Code=28, PDN Type Incorrect) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_21 ;;
            50) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-22 (ESM Reject Code=50, Only Support IPv4) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_22 ;;
            51) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-23 (ESM Reject Code=51, Only Support IPv6) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_23 ;;
            26) echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-24 (ESM Reject Code=26, Network Resource Insufficient) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_24 ;;
            *)  echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-25 (ESM Reject Code=${esm_cause}, Other PDN Reject Reasons) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_25 "$esm_cause" ;;
        esac
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 规则8-26: 无信号
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" = "99" ]; then
            if [ "$qeng_status" = "NOSERVICE" ] || [ "$qeng_status" = "SEARCH" ]; then
                ((sub_match_count++))
                echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-26 (No Signal) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_26
                echo ""
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-27: 信号极弱
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" != "99" ] && [ "$csq_value" -lt 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            ((sub_match_count++))
            echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-27 (Very Weak Signal, CSQ=${csq_value}) ━━━${NC}"
            output_rule8_27
            echo ""
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-28: 驻留到其他运营商小区，MCCMNC不匹配
    if [ "$cereg_is_0_or_2" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            if [ "$qeng_status" = "LIMSRV" ] && [ -n "$qeng_mccmnc" ] && [ -n "$imsi_mccmnc" ]; then
                if [ "$qeng_mccmnc" != "$imsi_mccmnc" ]; then
                    ((sub_match_count++))
                    echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-28 (Cell MCCMNC Mismatch: Cell=${qeng_mccmnc}, SIM=${imsi_mccmnc}) ━━━${NC}"
                    output_rule8_28
                    echo ""
                fi
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-29: 网络模式不是AUTO
    if [ "$cereg_all_0" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null; then
            if [ -n "$mode_pref" ] && [ "$mode_pref" != "AUTO" ]; then
                ((sub_match_count++))
                echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-29 (Network Mode Not AUTO: ${mode_pref}) ━━━${NC}"
                output_rule8_29
                echo ""
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-30: 长时间搜网
    if [ "$cereg_all_2" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        if [ "$csq_value" -ge 10 ] 2>/dev/null || [ "$csq_value" = "99" ]; then
            ((sub_match_count++))
            echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-30 (Long Time Search Network Status) ━━━${NC}"
            output_rule8_30
            echo ""
        fi
    fi
    
    # 规则8-31: 网络拒绝注册
    if [ "$cereg_all_3" = true ] && [ "$esm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-31 (Network Reject Registration, No Specific Reason) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_31
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 规则8-32: 未知状态
    if [ "$cereg_all_4" = true ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-32 (Unknown Registration Status) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_32
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 规则8-33: 5G拒绝但4G也未注册
    if [ "$cereg_all_not_1_or_5" = true ] && [ "$emm_cause" = "0" ] && [ "$fivegmm_cause" != "0" ]; then
        ((sub_match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule ${sub_match_count}: Rule 8-33 (5G Reject Code=${fivegmm_cause}, 4G Also Not Registered) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_33 "$fivegmm_cause"
        echo ""
    fi
    
    # 输出统计
    print_minor_separator
    if [ "$sub_match_count" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}No Sub-Rule Matched, Output Default Diagnosis...${NC}"
        echo ""
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━ Sub-Rule: Rule 8-Default (No Match Specific Sub-Rule) ━━━${NC}"
        output_rule8_default
    else
        echo -e "Rule 8 Matched ${CYAN}${sub_match_count}${NC} Sub-Rules"
    fi
    echo ""
}

#==============================================================================
# 主要规则匹配和输出函数（输出所有匹配的规则，不筛选）
#==============================================================================
output_diagnosis() {
    local module_status="${RESULTS[module_name.log]}"
    local sim_status="${RESULTS[sim_status.log]}"
    local airplane_status="${RESULTS[airplane_status.log]}"
    local network_status="${RESULTS[network_registration_status.log]}"
    local ps_status="${RESULTS[ps_status.log]}"
    local quectel_status="${RESULTS[quectel_cm.log]}"
    local ifconfig_status="${RESULTS[ifconfig.log]}"
    local public_status="${RESULTS[public_network_status.log]}"
    local acmp_status="${RESULTS[acmp_status.log]}"
    
    local match_count=0
    
    echo -e "${BLUE}【All Matched Rules Diagnostic Conclusions】${NC}"
    print_minor_separator
    echo ""
    
    # Rule 1: acmp_status.log = PASS
    if [ "$acmp_status" = "PASS" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 1 (ACMP Status Normal) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 1】" "${GREEN}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    The charging station's connection to the O&M network is normal.

  Recommended Actions:
    1. If the charging station status is normal, no action is required.
    2. If you believe the charging station is abnormal, check if the ACMP
       address is correct, or check if other charging stations with the same
       ACMP configuration are working properly to determine if it's an ACMP
       server issue.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # Rule 2: acmp_status.log = FAIL, public_network_status.log = PASS
    if [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "PASS" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 2 (Public Network Reachable but ACMP Unreachable) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 2】" "${YELLOW}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    The charging station can access public internet but cannot connect to
    the O&M network.

  Recommended Actions:
    1. Check if the ACMP address is correct. If not, please correct it.
    2. If the ACMP address is correct, connect the charging station to a
       mobile hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # Rule 3: acmp=FAIL, public=FAIL, ifconfig=PASS, quectel=PASS
    if [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$ifconfig_status" = "PASS" ] && [ "$quectel_status" = "PASS" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 3 (Data Dial-up Successful but Cannot Access Public Network) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 3】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    The charging station's cellular data datacall succeeded (IP address
    obtained), but cannot access public internet and connect to O&M platform.

  Recommended Actions:

    Action 1: Contact SIM card provider to verify APN configuration
    Please confirm the following:
      - Is the APN name correct;
      - Does the APN allocate IPv4 addresses (some IoT cards only support IPv6);
      - Is the authentication method correct (PAP, CHAP, or no authentication);
      - Is the SIM card data service normal (unpaid bills, data cap, regional
        restrictions, or device-binding policies).
    This is the most common cause, recommended to address first.

    Action 2: Try basic recovery operations
      2.1 Restart the charging station and observe if network connection
          is restored.
      2.2 If restart is ineffective and current firmware is not the latest
          stable version, contact technical support to evaluate firmware upgrade.

    Action 3: SIM card cross-validation
    Insert the SIM card into a mobile phone or 4G router for comparison testing:
      3.1 Manually configure the same APN parameters as the charging station
          and test internet access
          - Case A: If the comparison device cannot access internet, the problem
            is likely the SIM card itself, APN permissions, data service status
            (unpaid bills, exhausted data, device-binding), or local coverage.
          - Case B: If the comparison device can access internet normally, the
            SIM card and APN configuration are correct, proceed to Action 4.
      3.2 Use the comparison device's default (auto-obtained) APN configuration
          - Case A: If still cannot access internet, report test results to the
            SIM card provider and re-execute Action 1.
          - Case B: If can access internet normally, record all APN parameters
            and configure the same on the charging station.

    Action 4: Check ACMP (O&M platform) communication configuration
    Verify the following:
      - O&M server address (domain or IP);
      - Communication port and protocol;
      - Device ID, key, or certificate authentication information.

    Action 5: Enable temporary network channel for remote diagnosis
    If above steps fail, temporarily connect the charging station to a mobile
    hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # Rule 4: acmp=FAIL, public=FAIL, quectel=FAIL, ps=PASS
    if [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$ps_status" = "PASS" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 4 (PS Domain Normal but Data Dial-up Failed) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 4】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    PS domain network registration succeeded, but data datacall failed.

  Recommended Actions:

    Action 1: Contact SIM card provider to verify APN parameters
    Including APN name, IPv4/IPv4v6 support, authentication type PAP/CHAP/None,
    and confirm if data service is normal (data limits, unpaid bills, etc.).

    Action 2: Try basic recovery operations
      2.1 Restart the charging station and observe if network connection
          is restored.
      2.2 If restart is ineffective and current firmware is not the latest
          stable version, contact technical support to evaluate firmware upgrade.

    Action 3: SIM card cross-validation
    Insert the SIM card into a mobile phone or 4G router, use the default
    (auto-obtained) APN configuration to test internet access:
      - Case A: If still cannot access internet, report test results to the
        SIM card provider and re-execute Action 1.
      - Case B: If can access internet normally, record all APN parameters
        and configure the same on the charging station.

    Action 4: If above steps fail, connect the charging station to a mobile
    hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # Rule 5: acmp=FAIL, public=FAIL, quectel=FAIL, ps=FAIL, network=PASS
    if [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$ps_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$network_status" = "PASS" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 5 (Network Registered but PS Domain Abnormal) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 5】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    4G/5G network PS service is abnormal.

  Recommended Actions:

    Action 1: Contact SIM card provider
    Verify if data service is normal (data limits, unpaid bills, etc.), and
    confirm APN parameters (including APN name, IPv4/IPv4v6 support,
    authentication type PAP/CHAP/None).

    Action 2: Try basic recovery operations
      2.1 Restart the charging station and observe if network connection
          is restored.
      2.2 If restart is ineffective and current firmware is not the latest
          stable version, contact technical support to evaluate firmware upgrade.

    Action 3: SIM card cross-validation
    Insert the SIM card into a mobile phone and configure the same APN settings,
    test if the phone can access internet.
      - If the phone cannot access internet, report test results to the SIM card
        provider and re-execute Action 1.
      - If the phone works normally, insert the SIM card back into the charging
        station and connect to a mobile hotspot for issue reporting and
        cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # 规则6: module=PASS, airplane=FAIL, network=FAIL, ps=FAIL, quectel=FAIL, public=FAIL, acmp=FAIL
    if [ "$module_status" = "PASS" ] && [ "$airplane_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$network_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$ps_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 6 (Mobile Data Switch Disabled) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 6】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    Mobile data switch is disabled.

  Recommended Actions:

    1. Verify that the device is not connected via Ethernet or WiFi
       (these connections will automatically disable cellular data).

    2. If the above is ruled out, enable the data switch for SIM card 1.

    3. If step 2 does not resolve the issue:
       3.1 Restart the device and check if the problem is resolved.
       3.2 If the issue persists after restart, contact technical support
           to upgrade the charging station firmware to the latest version.

    4. If none of the above steps resolve the issue, connect the charging
       station to a mobile hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based
       deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # 规则7: 全部FAIL(除ifconfig外)
    if [ "$module_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$sim_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$airplane_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$network_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$ps_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 7 (5G Module Initialization Abnormal) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 7】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    5G module initialization is abnormal.

  Recommended Actions:

    1. Restart the device to see if the problem is resolved.

    2. If restart doesn't help, contact technical support to upgrade
       the charging station firmware.

    3. If above steps fail, connect the charging station to a mobile
       hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # 规则8: sim=PASS, airplane=PASS, network=FAIL, ps=FAIL, quectel=FAIL, public=FAIL, acmp=FAIL
    if [ "$sim_status" = "PASS" ] && [ "$airplane_status" = "PASS" ] && \
       [ "$network_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$ps_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ 匹配规则 ${match_count}: 规则8 (需要深度分析网络注册状态) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        echo ""
        analyze_rule8_full_output
    fi
    
    # 规则9: sim=FAIL, airplane=PASS, network=FAIL, ps=FAIL, quectel=FAIL, public=FAIL, acmp=FAIL
    if [ "$sim_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$airplane_status" = "PASS" ] && \
       [ "$network_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$ps_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$quectel_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 9 (SIM Card Status Abnormal) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 9】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    The charging station SIM card status is abnormal.

  Recommended Actions:

    1. The SIM card may not be installed or has poor contact with the SIM slot.
       Check if the SIM card is properly installed in the slot.

    2. Insert the SIM card into a mobile phone to verify if the SIM card
       itself has issues.

    3. If the SIM card works normally in the phone and SIM slot issues are
       ruled out, but the charging station still has problems, contact
       technical support to upgrade the firmware.

    4. If above steps fail, connect the charging station to a mobile hotspot
       for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # 规则10: quectel=PASS, ifconfig=FAIL, public=FAIL, acmp=FAIL
    if [ "$quectel_status" = "PASS" ] && [ "$ifconfig_status" = "FAIL" ] && \
       [ "$public_status" = "FAIL" ] && [ "$acmp_status" = "FAIL" ]; then
        ((match_count++))
        echo -e "${CYAN}━━━━━━━━━━ Matched Rule ${match_count}: Rule 10 (Data Dial-up Successful but No Valid IP) ━━━━━━━━━━${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Rule 10】" "${RED}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    Data dial-up succeeded but no valid IP address obtained.

  Recommended Actions:

    Action 1: Contact SIM card provider to verify APN parameters
    Including APN name, IPv4/IPv4v6 support, authentication type PAP/CHAP/None,
    and confirm if data service is normal (data limits, unpaid bills, etc.).

    Action 2: Try basic recovery operations
      2.1 Restart the charging station and observe if network connection
          is restored.
      2.2 If restart is ineffective and current firmware is not the latest
          stable version, contact technical support to evaluate firmware upgrade.

    Action 3: SIM card cross-validation
    Insert the SIM card into a mobile phone or 4G router, manually configure
    the same APN parameters as the charging station, and test internet access:
      - Case A: If the comparison device cannot access internet, the problem
        is likely the SIM card itself, APN permissions, data service status
        (unpaid bills, exhausted data, device-binding), or local coverage.
      - Case B: If the comparison device can access internet normally, the
        SIM card and APN configuration are correct, proceed to Action 4.

    Action 4: If above steps fail, connect the charging station to a mobile
    hotspot for issue reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    fi
    
    # Output match statistics
    print_minor_separator
    if [ "$match_count" -eq 0 ]; then
        echo -e "${YELLOW}No preset rules matched, outputting default diagnosis...${NC}"
        print_diagnosis_title "【AI Diagnosis Conclusion - Default】" "${YELLOW}"
        cat << 'EOF'
  Root Cause:
    Log status combination did not match any preset rules,
    further analysis required.

  Recommended Actions:

    1. Restart the device and observe if the problem is resolved.

    2. Check SIM card status, insert the SIM card into a mobile phone
       to verify if it works normally.

    3. Check if APN configuration is correct.

    4. Connect the charging station to a mobile hotspot for issue
       reporting and cloud-based deep analysis.
EOF
        print_diagnosis_footer
    else
        echo -e "Total ${CYAN}${match_count}${NC} main rules matched"
    fi
}

#==============================================================================
# Extract and Display Key Log Information
#==============================================================================
show_key_log_info() {
    echo ""
    print_separator
    echo -e "${BLUE}【Key Log Information Summary】${NC}"
    print_separator
    
    # 去除Windows换行符后处理 (tr -d '\r')
    
    # 提取模组信息 (纯大写字母和数字组成，长度>15，整行只有这个字符串)
    local module_info=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep -E "^[A-Z0-9]{16,}$" | head -1)
    if [ -n "$module_info" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "5G Module Model" "$module_info"
    fi
    
    # 提取IMSI (15位纯数字)
    local imsi=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep -E "^[0-9]{15}$" | head -1)
    if [ -n "$imsi" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "SIM Card IMSI" "$imsi"
    fi
    
    # 提取运营商信息
    local operator=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep '+COPS:' | grep '"' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$operator" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "Network Carrier" "$operator"
    fi
    
    # 提取网络类型 (优先从+QENG获取实际网络类型，备选从+QNWINFO获取)
    local network_type=""
    local service_status=""
    
    # 先从+QENG获取实际网络类型和服务状态
    local qeng_line=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep '+QENG:.*servingcell' | tail -1)
    if [ -n "$qeng_line" ]; then
        # 提取服务状态 (第二个参数，如LIMSRV, NOSERVICE, SEARCH等)
        service_status=$(echo "$qeng_line" | sed 's/.*"servingcell","\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
        # 提取网络类型 (第三个参数，如WCDMA, LTE, NR5G等)
        local rat_type=$(echo "$qeng_line" | sed 's/.*"servingcell","[^"]*","\([^"]*\)".*/\1/')
        if [ -n "$rat_type" ] && [ "$rat_type" != "$qeng_line" ]; then
            if [ "$service_status" = "LIMSRV" ]; then
                network_type="${rat_type} (Limited Service)"
            elif [ "$service_status" = "NOSERVICE" ] || [ "$service_status" = "SEARCH" ]; then
                network_type="No Service"
            else
                network_type="$rat_type"
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    # 如果+QENG没有获取到，从+QNWINFO获取
    if [ -z "$network_type" ]; then
        local qnwinfo_line=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep '+QNWINFO:' | tail -1)
        if [ -n "$qnwinfo_line" ]; then
            # 尝试提取引号内的内容 (如: +QNWINFO: "LTE",...)
            network_type=$(echo "$qnwinfo_line" | sed -n 's/.*+QNWINFO:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
            # 如果没有引号，提取冒号后的内容 (如: +QNWINFO: No Service)
            if [ -z "$network_type" ]; then
                network_type=$(echo "$qnwinfo_line" | sed 's/.*+QNWINFO:[[:space:]]*//')
            fi
        fi
    fi
    
    if [ -n "$network_type" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "Network Type" "$network_type"
    fi
    
    # 提取信号强度
    local csq=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep '+CSQ:' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*+CSQ:[[:space:]]*\([0-9]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$csq" ]; then
        if [ "$csq" = "99" ]; then
            printf "%-24s : %s (Unknown/No Signal)\n" "4G Signal Strength (CSQ)" "$csq"
        else
            local dbm=$((csq * 2 - 113))
            printf "%-24s : %s (approx. %sdBm)\n" "4G Signal Strength (CSQ)" "$csq" "$dbm"
        fi
    fi
    
    # 提取IP地址
    local ip_addr=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep 'inet addr:' | head -1 | sed 's/.*inet addr:\([0-9.]*\).*/\1/')
    if [ -n "$ip_addr" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "IPv4 Address" "$ip_addr"
    fi
    
    # 提取ACMP目标地址
    local acmp_host=$(tr -d '\r' < "$LOG_FILE" | grep 'Current Target Host:' | sed 's/.*Current Target Host:[[:space:]]*\(.*\)/\1/')
    if [ -n "$acmp_host" ]; then
        printf "%-24s : %s\n" "ACMP O&M Server" "$acmp_host"
    fi
    
    print_minor_separator
}

    echo ""

}

#==============================================================================
# 主函数
#==============================================================================
main() {
    # 执行诊断并捕获输出
    local diagnosis_output
    diagnosis_output=$(run_diagnosis)
    
    # 输出到终端（带颜色）
    echo "$diagnosis_output"
    
    # 去除颜色代码并保存到Markdown文件
    local clean_output

    local output_file="${OUTPUT_DIR}/${OUTPUT_FILENAME}"
    save_report_to_md "$output_file" "$clean_output"
}

main

# 网络注册诊断规则库

## 概述

本文档针对 `network_registration_status.log` 日志中的各字段返回值组合，采用穷举法逐条列出所有可能的故障场景及对应处理方案。

### 关键诊断字段详细说明

在 `network_registration_status.log` 中，需要检查以下AT命令的返回值：

---

#### 字段1：AT+COPS? - 运营商注册状态

**返回格式**：`+COPS: <mode>[,<format>,<oper>[,<AcT>]]`

| 返回示例 | 参数个数 | 含义 | 诊断判断 |
|----------|---------|------|---------|
| `+COPS: 0,0,"CHN-CT",7` | 4个参数 | 已注册到运营商 | ✅ 网络已注册 |
| `+COPS: 0,2,"46011",7` | 4个参数 | 已注册（数字格式） | ✅ 网络已注册 |
| `+COPS: 0` | 1个参数 | 未注册到任何运营商 | ❌ 网络未注册 |

**AcT值含义**（第4个参数）：
| AcT | 网络制式 |
|-----|---------|
|2 |UTRAN|
|4 |UTRAN W/HSDPA|
|5 |UTRAN W/HSUPA|
|6 |UTRAN W/HSDPA and HSUPA|
|7 |E-UTRAN|
|10 |E-UTRAN connected to 5GCN|
|11 |NR connected to 5GCN|
|12 |NG-RAN|
|13 |E-UTRAN-NR dual connectivity|
---

#### 字段2：AT+CEREG? - 4G EPS注册状态（最重要）

**返回格式**：`+CEREG: <n>,<stat>[,<tac>,<ci>[,<AcT>]]`

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| n | URC上报配置（0-4） |
| **stat** | **注册状态（关键字段）** |
| tac | 跟踪区域码 |
| ci | 小区ID |
| AcT | 接入技术 |

**stat值详细说明**：
| stat值 | 含义 | 英文说明 | 是否故障 | 处理方式 |
|--------|------|---------|---------|---------|
| **0** | 未注册，未搜索 | Not registered, MT is not currently searching | ❌ 需排查 | 检查网络模式/频段/PS附着 |
| **1** | 已注册，归属网络 | Registered, home network | ✅ **正常** | 无需处理 |
| **2** | 未注册，正在搜索 | Not registered, but MT is currently trying to attach | ⏳ 等待 | 等待>2分钟则需排查 |
| **3** | 注册被拒绝 | Registration denied | ❌ 需排查 | 检查QNETRC拒绝码 |
| **4** | 未知状态 | Unknown | ❌ 需排查 | 重启设备 |
| **5** | 已注册，漫游 | Registered, roaming | ✅ **正常** | 无需处理 |

---

#### 字段3：AT+C5GREG? - 5G NR注册状态

**返回格式**：`+C5GREG: <n>,<stat>[,[<tac>],[<ci>],[<AcT>],[<Allowed_NSSAI_length>],[<Allowed_NSSAI>]]`

| stat值 | 含义 | 处理方式 |
|--------|------|---------|
| 0 | 未注册，未搜索 | **若CEREG stat=1或5，则忽略** |
| 1 | 已注册，归属网络 | 正常 |
| 2 | 未注册，正在搜索 | **若CEREG stat=1或5，则忽略** |
| 3 | 注册被拒绝 | **若CEREG stat=1或5，则忽略** |
| 4 | 未知状态 | **若CEREG stat=1或5，则忽略** |
| 5 | 已注册，漫游 | 正常 |
| 8 | 仅紧急服务注册 | 数据业务不可用 |

> **重要**：5G状态仅在CEREG也异常时才需要关注，4G正常则5G问题不是故障。

---

#### 字段4：AT+QNETRC? - 网络拒绝码

**返回格式**：
```
+QNETRC: "emm_cause",<value>      // 4G EMM层拒绝码 (3GPP 24.301)
+QNETRC: "esm_cause",<value>      // 4G ESM层拒绝码 (3GPP 24.301)  
+QNETRC: "5gmm_cause",<value>     // 5G 5GMM层拒绝码 (3GPP 24.501)
```

**各拒绝码类型说明**：
| 拒绝码类型 | 协议层 | 值=0 | 值≠0 | 优先级 |
|-----------|--------|------|------|--------|
| emm_cause | 4G网络层(EMM) | 4G网络层无拒绝 | 4G注册被拒，需排查 | **最高** |
| esm_cause | 4G会话层(ESM) | 4G PDN无拒绝 | APN/PDN相关问题 | 高 |
| 5gmm_cause | 5G网络层(5GMM) | 5G网络层无拒绝 | **若4G正常则忽略** | 低 |

**常见emm_cause值速查**：
| 值 | 名称 | 常见原因 |
|----|------|---------|
| 2 | IMSI unknown in HSS | SIM卡未开通/已注销 |
| 3 | Illegal UE | 欠费/停机/黑名单 |
| 5 | IMEI not accepted | 设备IMEI被限制 |
| 6 | Illegal ME | 设备未认证 |
| 7 | EPS services not allowed | SIM卡不支持4G |
| 8 | EPS and non-EPS not allowed | 所有服务被禁 |
| 11 | PLMN not allowed | 运营商限制 |
| 12 | TA not allowed | 区域限制 |
| 13 | Roaming not allowed | 漫游未开通 |
| 14 | EPS not allowed in PLMN | 当前PLMN不支持4G |
| 15 | No suitable cells | 无覆盖/天线问题 |
| 22 | Congestion | 网络拥塞 |
| 42 | Severe network failure | 网络故障 |

**常见esm_cause值速查**：
| 值 | 名称 | 常见原因 |
|----|------|---------|
| 8 | Operator Determined Barring | 运营商限制数据业务 |
| 26 | Insufficient resources | 网络资源不足 |
| 27 | Missing or unknown APN | **APN名称错误** |
| 28 | Unknown PDN type | IP类型配置错误 |
| 29 | User authentication failed | **用户名/密码错误** |
| 33 | Service not subscribed | **未订购数据服务** |
| 50 | PDN type IPv4 only | 仅支持IPv4 |
| 51 | PDN type IPv6 only | 仅支持IPv6 |

---

#### 字段5：AT+CSQ - 信号强度

**返回格式**：`+CSQ: <rssi>,<ber>`

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| rssi | 接收信号强度指示 |
| ber | 误码率（通常为99表示未知） |

**rssi值与信号强度对照表**：
| rssi值 | dBm范围 | 信号质量 | 诊断判断 | 处理建议 |
|--------|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| 0 | ≤ -113 dBm | 极差 | ❌ 几乎无信号 | 检查天线连接 |
| 1 | -111 dBm | 极差 | ❌ 信号极弱 | 检查天线连接 |
| 2-9 | -109 ~ -95 dBm | 差 | ⚠️ 信号弱 | 优化天线位置 |
| 10-14 | -93 ~ -85 dBm | 一般 | ⏳ 可接受 | 可尝试优化 |
| 15-19 | -83 ~ -75 dBm | 良好 | ✅ 正常 | 无需处理 |
| 20-30 | -73 ~ -53 dBm | 优秀 | ✅ 正常 | 无需处理 |
| 31 | ≥ -51 dBm | 极佳 | ✅ 正常 | 无需处理 |
| **99** | 未知 | **无信号** | ❌ **重点排查** | 天线/覆盖问题 |

---

#### 字段6：AT+QCSQ - 详细信号质量

**返回格式**：`+QCSQ: <sysmode>,<value1>,<value2>,<value3>,<value4>`

**不同网络制式的返回值含义**：
| sysmode | value1 | value2 | value3 | value4 |
|---------|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| "NOSERVICE" | - | - | - | - |
| "WCDMA" | rssi | rscp | ecio | - |
| "LTE" | rssi | rsrp | sinr×10 | rsrq |
| "NR5G" | rsrp | sinr | rsrq | - |

**LTE模式参数参考值**：
| 参数 | 优秀 | 良好 | 一般 | 较差 | 很差 |
|------|------|------|------|------|------|
| RSRP (dBm) | > -80 | -80~-90 | -90~-100 | -100~-110 | < -110 |
| SINR (dB) | > 20 | 13~20 | 0~13 | -5~0 | < -5 |
| RSRQ (dB) | > -10 | -10~-15 | -15~-20 | < -20 | - |

**示例解析**：
```
+QCSQ: "LTE",-59,-92,143,-13
```
- sysmode = "LTE"（4G网络）
- rssi = -59 dBm（信号强度好）
- rsrp = -92 dBm（参考信号功率，一般）
- sinr = 143 ÷ 10 = 14.3 dB（信噪比，良好）
- rsrq = -13 dB（参考信号质量，良好）

---

#### 字段7：AT+QENG="SERVINGCELL" - 服务小区信息

**返回格式（LTE模式）**：
```
+QENG: "servingcell",<state>,"LTE",<is_tdd>,<MCC>,<MNC>,<cellID>,<PCID>,
       <earfcn>,<freq_band_ind>,<UL_bandwidth>,<DL_bandwidth>,<TAC>,
       <RSRP>,<RSRQ>,<RSSI>,<SINR>,<CQI>,<tx_power>,<srxlev>
```

**关键字段说明**：
| 字段 | 说明 | 诊断用途 |
|------|------|---------|
| **state** | 小区驻留状态 | 判断注册进度 |
| MCC | 移动国家码 | 判断PLMN匹配 |
| MNC | 移动网络码 | 判断PLMN匹配 |
| freq_band_ind | 频段 | 判断频段支持 |
| RSRP | 参考信号功率 | 信号强度 |
| SINR | 信噪比 | 信号质量 |

**state字段值详细说明**：
| state值 | 含义 | 英文说明 | 诊断意义 | 处理方式 |
|---------|------|---------|---------|---------|
| "NOSERVICE" | 无服务 | No service | 完全无信号 | 检查天线/覆盖 |
| "SEARCH" | 搜索中 | UE is searching but cannot find a suitable cell | 正在搜网，未找到小区 | 等待或检查信号 |
| "LIMSRV" | 受限服务 | UE is camping on a cell but has not registered | **驻留小区但未注册** | 检查PLMN/模式/频段 |
| "NOCONN" | 已注册空闲 | UE is camping and registered, no call in progress | ✅ 正常，空闲态 | 无需处理 |
| "CONNECT" | 已注册连接 | UE is camping and registered, call in progress | ✅ 正常，有业务 | 无需处理 |

#### 字段8：AT+QNWINFO - 当前网络信息

**返回格式**：`+QNWINFO: <AcT>,<oper>,<band>,<channel>`

| 字段 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| AcT | 接入技术（网络制式） |
| oper | 运营商（数字格式） |
| band | 频段 |
| channel | 信道号 |

**AcT值说明**：
| AcT | 含义 | 说明 |
|-----|------|------|
| "NONE" | 无服务 | 未注册到任何网络 |
| "WCDMA" | 3G | WCDMA网络 |
| "FDD LTE" | 4G FDD | FDD制式LTE |
| "TDD LTE" | 4G TDD | TDD制式LTE |
| "FDD NR5G" | 5G FDD | FDD制式5G NR |
| "TDD NR5G" | 5G TDD | TDD制式5G NR |

**特殊返回值**：
- `+QNWINFO: No Service` - 表示未注册到任何网络
- 5G NSA模式会同时返回LTE和5G信息

#### 字段9：AT+QNWPREFCFG="mode_pref" - 网络模式配置

**返回格式**：`+QNWPREFCFG: "mode_pref",<mode_pref>`

**mode_pref值说明**：
| mode_pref | 含义 | 支持的网络 |
|-----------|------|-----------|
| AUTO | 自动模式 | WCDMA + LTE + NR5G |
| WCDMA | 仅3G | 仅WCDMA |
| LTE | 仅4G | 仅LTE |
| NR5G | 仅5G | 仅NR |
| LTE:NR5G | 4G+5G | LTE + NR5G |
| WCDMA:LTE | 3G+4G | WCDMA + LTE |

**诊断用途**：
- 如果配置为仅某种模式，但当地无该网络覆盖，会导致无法注册
- 建议配置为AUTO或LTE:NR5G

#### 字段10：AT+QICSGP - APN配置查询

### 字段组合速查表

| 字段 | 来源AT命令 | 关键取值 | 诊断意义 |
|------|-----------|---------|---------|
| COPS参数个数 | AT+COPS? | 4个=已注册, 非4个=未注册 | 判断是否注册成功 |
| CEREG_stat | AT+CEREG? | 1或5=正常, 其他=异常 | **最重要的判断依据** |
| C5GREG_stat | AT+C5GREG? | 1或5=正常 | 仅4G异常时才关注 |
| emm_cause | AT+QNETRC? | 0=正常, 非0=拒绝 | 4G网络层拒绝原因 |
| esm_cause | AT+QNETRC? | 0=正常, 非0=拒绝 | 4G会话层拒绝原因 |
| 5gmm_cause | AT+QNETRC? | 非0但4G正常=忽略 | 5G网络层拒绝原因 |
| CSQ_rssi | AT+CSQ | 99=无信号, <10=弱 | 信号强度判断 |
| QCSQ_rsrp | AT+QCSQ | <-110=很差 | 详细信号质量 |
| QENG_state | AT+QENG | LIMSRV=驻留未注册 | 小区驻留状态 |
| QENG_MCC_MNC | AT+QENG | 与SIM卡运营商对比 | PLMN匹配判断 |
| QNWINFO_AcT | AT+QNWINFO | No Service=未注册 | 当前网络制式 |
| mode_pref | AT+QNWPREFCFG | AUTO/LTE/NR5G等 | 网络模式配置 |
| APN | AT+QICSGP | APN名称 | APN配置正确性 |

### 核心判断原则

> **充电桩产品最终目标是数据业务可用、设备不离线，不在乎使用4G还是5G。**
> **只要CEREG_stat=1或5（4G已注册），即使有5G拒绝码也不视为故障。**

## 规则0：非故障场景（优先级最高）

### 规则0-1：4G已注册，5G有拒绝码

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 1 或 5（4G已注册）
- 5gmm_cause ≠ 0（5G有拒绝码）
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：只要 CEREG_stat = 1 或 5，无论5G拒绝码是什么值，都判定为【非故障】。

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备已成功注册到4G网络，数据业务正常可用。5G网络存在拒绝码但不影响业务。
建议措施：
1、无需处理，设备工作正常。
2、5G拒绝码仅供参考记录，不影响充电桩正常联网功能。
```

### 规则0-2：4G已注册，无任何拒绝码

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 1 或 5（4G已注册）
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- 5gmm_cause = 0
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：CEREG_stat = 1 或 5，且所有拒绝码均为0。

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备已成功注册到4G网络，网络状态完全正常。
建议措施：
1、无需处理，设备工作正常。
2、如仍有业务异常，请再次触发AI诊断流程。
```

---

## 规则1：EMM拒绝码场景（4G网络层拒绝）

> 以下规则适用于：CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5（4G未注册），且 emm_cause ≠ 0

### 规则1-1：emm_cause = 2（IMSI unknown in HSS）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 2
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 2

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡的IMSI在运营商网络中不存在，可能是SIM卡未正确开通或已被注销。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认SIM卡是否已正确入网开通。
2、确认SIM卡账户状态，是否已被注销。
3、将SIM卡插入手机，验证是否能识别运营商。
4、如手机也无法识别运营商，请更换SIM卡。
```

### 规则1-2：emm_cause = 3（Illegal UE）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 3
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 3

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备被网络判定为非法UE，通常是SIM卡业务问题（欠费、停机、黑名单）。
建议措施：
1、【优先】联系SIM卡提供商，确认账户状态：
   - 是否欠费或停机；
   - 是否被列入黑名单；
   - 数据业务是否正常开通。
2、将SIM卡插入手机，验证是否能正常使用。
3、如手机也无法正常使用该SIM卡，联系SIM卡商处理或更换SIM卡。
4、如手机可以正常使用，则使充电桩连接手机热点，进行问题反馈并执行云端深度分析。
```

### 规则1-3：emm_cause = 5（IMEI not accepted）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 5
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 5

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备IMEI不被运营商网络接受，可能是IMEI被列入黑名单或未通过入网认证。
建议措施：
1、联系运营商确认设备IMEI状态，是否被列入黑名单。
2、尝试使用其他运营商的SIM卡测试，确认是否为特定运营商限制。
3、如问题持续存在于所有运营商，可能需要联系设备厂商确认IMEI认证状态。
4、记录设备IMEI号，联系技术支持进一步分析。
```

### 规则1-4：emm_cause = 6（Illegal ME）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 6
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 6

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备被运营商网络判定为非法移动设备，可能未通过入网认证。
建议措施：
1、联系运营商确认设备认证状态。
2、确认设备是否支持当地运营商网络。
3、尝试使用其他运营商的SIM卡测试。
4、联系设备厂商确认入网认证情况。
```

### 规则1-5：emm_cause = 7（EPS services not allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 7
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 7

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡不被允许使用4G(EPS)服务，可能是SIM卡套餐不支持4G或为老旧2G/3G卡或流量使用完。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认该SIM卡套餐是否支持4G数据业务，是否欠费。
2、检查SIM卡是否为仅支持2G/3G的老卡，如是则需更换支持4G的SIM卡。
3、联系提供商开通4G数据服务。
4、将SIM卡插入手机验证是否能注册到4G网络。
```

### 规则1-6：emm_cause = 8（EPS and non-EPS services not allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 8
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 8

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡的所有移动服务（包括2G/3G/4G）均被禁止，通常是严重欠费或账户被冻结。
建议措施：
1、【紧急】联系SIM卡提供商，确认账户状态：
   - 是否严重欠费导致账户冻结；
   - 是否被运营商主动停用；
   - 是否存在异常使用被封禁。
2、恢复账户服务后重启设备测试。
3、如无法恢复，需更换SIM卡。
```

### 规则1-7：emm_cause = 11（PLMN not allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 11
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 11

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡不允许在当前运营商网络(PLMN)注册，可能是运营商限制或漫游未开通。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡商查询SIM卡支持的运营商列表，确认当前所在地的运营商是否被当前SIM卡支持。
2、如为漫游场景（设备不在SIM卡归属地），联系SIM卡商，确认是否已开通漫游服务。
3、联系SIM卡提供商确认PLMN限制策略。
4、如当地只有其他运营商覆盖，更换与当地网络匹配的SIM卡。
```

### 规则1-8：emm_cause = 12（Tracking Area not allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 12
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 12

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡不允许在当前跟踪区域(TA)注册，存在区域使用限制。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认该SIM卡的服务区域范围。
2、确认是否存在区域限制策略（如仅限某地区使用等）。
3、如为区域限制导致，需在限定区域内使用或更换无区域限制的SIM卡。
```

### 规则1-9：emm_cause = 13（Roaming not allowed in this TA）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 13
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 13

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：当前区域不允许漫游，设备处于非归属地但SIM卡未开通漫游服务。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，开通漫游服务。
2、确认漫游服务开通后，重启设备测试。
3、如无法开通漫游，更换当地运营商的SIM卡。
```

### 规则1-10：emm_cause = 14（EPS services not allowed in this PLMN）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 14
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 14

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡的4G服务不覆盖当前运营商网络，可能是运营商合作限制。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认该卡支持的运营商网络列表。
2、如当前运营商不在支持列表内，更换其他运营商的SIM卡。
3、确认是否有运营商合作限制（如虚拟运营商卡的限制）。
```

### 规则1-11：emm_cause = 15（No suitable cells in tracking area）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 15
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 15

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：当前跟踪区域内没有合适的小区可供注册，通常是网络覆盖问题或天线问题。
建议措施：
1、【首先】检查天线连接：
   - 确认天线接头是否牢固连接到模组天线端口；
   - 检查天线线缆是否有断裂或损坏；
   - 检查天线是否被金属物体遮挡。
2、验证当地网络覆盖：
   - 将SIM卡插入手机，确认当地是否有4G网络信号；
   - 如手机有信号而设备无信号，重点检查设备天线或射频问题。
3、优化天线位置：
   - 将天线移到窗户附近或室外；
   - 避免天线被金属外壳包裹。
4、如天线和覆盖都正常，是充电桩连接手机热点进行一键反馈，使用云端大模型进行深度分析。
```

### 规则1-12：emm_cause = 22（Congestion）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 22
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 22

**输出结论**：

```
问题原因：当前网络拥塞，运营商网络负载过高暂时拒绝注册请求。
建议措施：
1、等待几分钟后，重启设备重新尝试注册。
2、如持续出现（超过30分钟），可能是网络侧故障：
   - 联系运营商确认当地网络状态；
   - 询问是否有网络维护或故障。
3、如问题持续，尝试更换其他运营商SIM卡测试。
```

### 规则1-13：emm_cause = 42（Severe network failure）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 42
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：emm_cause = 42

**输出结论**：

```
问题原因：运营商网络侧发生严重故障。
建议措施：
1、等待后重试，网络故障通常会在一定时间内恢复。
2、如持续出现（超过1小时），联系运营商反馈网络问题。
3、可尝试更换其他运营商SIM卡作为临时方案。
```


## 规则2：ESM拒绝码场景（4G PDN连接层拒绝）

> 以下规则适用于：CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5（4G未注册），且 esm_cause ≠ 0

### 规则2-1：esm_cause = 27（Missing or unknown APN）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 27
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 27

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：APN名称配置错误或网络不识别该APN。
建议措施：
1、【优先】联系SIM卡提供商，获取正确的APN信息：
   - APN名称（必须完全正确，区分大小写）；
   - 用户名和密码（如需要）；
   - 认证方式（PAP/CHAP/无认证）。
2、检查当前APN配置：
   - 重启设备之后再次检查APN配置页面中的APN信息
   - 对比是否与SIM卡商提供的信息一致。
3、修正APN配置后，重启设备测试。
4、将SIM卡插入手机，使用手机默认APN测试上网：
   - 如手机可上网，记录手机自动获取的APN参数，配置到充电桩。
```

### 规则2-2：esm_cause = 29（User authentication failed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 29
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 29

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：APN用户名或密码错误，认证失败。
建议措施：
1、【优先】联系SIM卡提供商，确认正确的认证信息：
   - 用户名；
   - 密码；
   - 认证方式（PAP/CHAP/无认证）。
2、检查当前配置：
   - 重启设备之后再次检查APN配置页面中的APN信息
   - 核对用户名、密码、认证方式是否正确。
3、注意事项：
   - 部分APN不需要用户名密码，此时应留空；
   - 认证方式不匹配也会导致失败（如APN要求CHAP但配置了PAP）。
4、修正配置后，重启设备测试。
```

### 规则2-3：esm_cause = 33（Requested service option not subscribed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 33
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 33

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：SIM卡未订购数据服务，无法建立数据连接。
建议措施：
1、【优先】联系SIM卡提供商，确认并开通数据业务：
   - 确认未欠费；
   - 确认是否已开通数据/流量服务；
   - 确认是否有流量包或套餐；
   - 确认是否存在流量封顶或限制。
2、如已开通数据业务但仍失败：
   - 确认APN配置是否正确；
   - 确认是否有特殊的数据业务限制。
3、开通数据业务后，重启设备测试。
```

### 规则2-4：esm_cause = 8（Operator Determined Barring）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 8
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 8

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：运营商限制了该SIM卡的数据业务。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认数据业务是否被限制：
   - 是否存在流量封顶后限速或停止数据服务；
   - 是否有特殊的业务限制策略；
   - 是否需要开通或恢复数据服务。
2、确认限制解除后，重启设备测试。
```

### 规则2-5：esm_cause = 28（Unknown PDN type）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 28
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 28

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：PDP/PDN类型配置不正确，网络不支持当前配置的IP类型。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认支持的IP类型：
   - IPv4（最常用）；
   - IPv6；
   - IPv4v6（双栈）。
2、检查当前配置：
   - 重启设备并检查APN配置页面中的的IP类型设置。
3、修改为正确的IP类型：
   - 如不确定，优先尝试IPv4；
   - 部分物联网卡可能仅支持IPv6，但我们的充电桩设备仅支持IPV4 only。
```

### 规则2-6：esm_cause = 50（PDN type IPv4 only allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 50
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 50

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：网络仅支持IPv4，但当前配置了其他IP类型。
建议措施：
1、将PDP类型修改为IPv4。
2、重启设备，并再次检查IP类型为IPV4或者是IP
3、修改后重启设备测试。
```

### 规则2-7：esm_cause = 51（PDN type IPv6 only allowed）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 51
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 51

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：网络仅支持IPv6，但当前配置了IPv4或其他类型。
建议措施：
1、设备不支持IPv6，需联系SIM卡提供商更换支持IPv4的APN或SIM卡。
```

### 规则2-8：esm_cause = 26（Insufficient resources）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause = 26
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause = 26

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：网络资源不足，无法建立PDN连接。
建议措施：
1、等待几分钟后重试。
2、重启设备重新尝试。
3、如持续出现，联系运营商确认网络状态。
```

### 规则2-9：esm_cause = 其他非零值

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- esm_cause ≠ 0 且不在上述列出的值中
- 其他字段：无所谓

**判断条件**：esm_cause为其他非零值

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：PDN连接建立失败，拒绝码为#[具体值]。
建议措施：
1、联系SIM卡提供商，确认APN配置和数据业务状态。
2、将SIM卡插入手机测试上网功能。
3、记录具体拒绝码（esm_cause=[具体值]），将充电桩连接手机热点，并执行一键反馈功能，触发云端大模型深度分析。
```

## 规则3：无拒绝码 + 信号问题场景

> 以下规则适用于：CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5，且所有拒绝码均为0

### 规则3-1：完全无信号（CSQ=99）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- 5gmm_cause = 0
- CSQ_rssi = 99
- QENG_state = NOSERVICE 或 SEARCH

**判断条件**：所有拒绝码均为0，且CSQ_rssi = 99

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备完全无蜂窝网络信号，可能是天线问题或当地无网络覆盖。
建议措施：
措施1：检查天线连接
- 确认天线接头是否牢固连接到模组天线端口；
- 检查天线线缆是否有断裂或损坏；
- 检查天线接头是否有氧化或腐蚀。

措施2：检查天线位置
- 确认天线没有被金属外壳完全包裹；
- 将天线移到窗户附近或室外位置；
- 避免天线靠近大型金属物体。

措施3：验证当地网络覆盖
- 将SIM卡插入手机，确认当地是否有网络信号；
- 如手机显示有信号格，问题在设备端（天线或射频）；
- 如手机也无信号，当地确实无网络覆盖，需更换部署位置或使用其他联网方式。

措施4：硬件排查（如以上均无效）
- 尝试更换天线测试；
- 联系技术支持进行射频硬件诊断。
```

### 规则3-2：信号极弱（CSQ < 10）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- 5gmm_cause = 0
- CSQ_rssi < 10 且 ≠ 99

**判断条件**：所有拒绝码均为0，且0 < CSQ_rssi < 10

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备蜂窝网络信号极弱（低于-95dBm），可能导致无法稳定注册网络。
建议措施：
措施1：优化天线位置
- 调整天线方向和角度；
- 将天线移到更开阔的位置；
- 避免天线被遮挡。

措施2：改善信号环境
- 将设备移动到窗户附近；
- 将设备从地下室移到地面层；
- 避开金属密集区域。

措施3：更换天线

措施4：对比测试
- 将SIM卡插入手机对比信号强度；
- 如手机信号明显更好，检查设备天线系统。
```

---

## 规则4：无拒绝码 + 驻留小区但未注册场景

> 以下规则适用于：CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5，所有拒绝码均为0，且有小区信息但未注册

### 规则4-1：PLMN不匹配（驻留到其他运营商小区）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 0 或 2
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- CSQ_rssi >= 10（有信号）
- QENG_state = LIMSRV（驻留但未注册）
- QENG_MCC_MNC 与 SIM卡运营商不一致

**判断条件**：有信号有小区，但QENG中的MCC/MNC与SIM卡的MCC/MNC不匹配


**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备驻留到其他运营商的小区，与SIM卡运营商不匹配，无法发起注册。这通常是因为SIM卡对应运营商在当地信号较弱。
建议措施：
措施1：验证目标运营商覆盖
- 将SIM卡插入手机，确认当地该运营商是否有网络覆盖；
- 如手机能正常注册网络，问题可能在设备天线。

措施2：优化天线获取目标运营商信号
- 调整天线位置和方向；
- 尝试获取SIM卡对应运营商的更强信号。

措施3：检查频段支持
- 确认设备支持的频段是否包含目标运营商的主力频段。

措施4：更换SIM卡
- 如当地确实只有其他运营商的覆盖，更换与当地网络匹配的SIM卡。
```

### 规则4-2：网络模式不匹配

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 0
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- CSQ_rssi >= 10（有信号）
- QENG_state = LIMSRV 或 NOCONN
- mode_pref 配置与当地网络不匹配（如配置仅3G但当地只有4G）

**判断条件**：有信号有小区，但网络模式配置与驻留小区制式不匹配

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备配置的网络模式与当地可用网络不匹配，导致无法注册。
建议措施：

措施1：检查修改网络模式为AUTO
- 配置命令：AT+QNWPREFCFG="mode_pref",AUTO
- 修改后重启设备测试。

措施2：确认当地网络制式
- 将SIM卡插入手机确认当地主要网络制式；
- 根据实际情况调整网络模式配置。
```



### 规则4-3：长时间停留在搜网状态（stat=2）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 2（长时间停留，超过2分钟）
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0
- CSQ_rssi >= 10 或 = 99

**判断条件**：CEREG_stat = 2 超过2分钟

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备长时间停留在搜网状态，无法完成网络注册。
建议措施：
措施1：重启设备重新搜网
- 重启后观察是否能在2分钟内完成注册。

措施2：检查PLMN匹配
- 参考规则4-1，确认驻留小区与SIM卡运营商是否匹配。

措施3：检查网络模式配置
- 参考规则4-2，确认网络模式配置是否正确。


措施4：交叉验证
- 将SIM卡插入手机验证是否能正常注册；
- 将手机中可用的SIM卡插入充电桩中，验证能否恢复在线

措施5：
- 使充电桩连接手机热点，进行问题反馈并执行云端深度分析。
```

---

## 规则5：注册状态异常场景

### 规则5-1：注册被拒但无拒绝码（stat=3, 拒绝码=0）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 3（注册被拒）
- emm_cause = 0
- esm_cause = 0

**判断条件**：CEREG_stat = 3 但所有拒绝码均为0

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：网络拒绝了注册请求，但未返回具体拒绝原因。
建议措施：
措施1：重启设备重试
- 开关数据开关或重启设备后重新尝试注册。

措施2：检查SIM卡状态
- 将SIM卡插入手机验证是否能正常注册网络。

措施3：检查APN配置
- 确保APN配置正确（参考规则2-1）。

措施4：联系SIM卡提供商
- 确认SIM卡业务状态是否正常。

措施5：如以上均无效
- 使充电桩连接手机热点，进行问题反馈并执行云端深度分析。
```

### 规则5-2：注册状态未知（stat=4）

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat = 4（未知状态）

**判断条件**：CEREG_stat = 4

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：设备网络注册状态异常，处于未知状态。
建议措施：
措施1：重启设备
- 重启后观察状态是否恢复正常。

措施2：如持续出现
- 可能是模组固件问题；
- 联系技术支持，评估是否需要固件升级。
```

---

## 规则6：5G拒绝码场景（仅当4G也不可用时处理）

> **重要提示**：以下规则仅在 CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5（4G未注册）时才需要处理。
> 如果4G已正常注册，5G拒绝码应被忽略（参考规则0-1）。

### 规则6-1：5gmm_cause ≠ 0 且 4G也失败

**字段组合**：
- CEREG_stat ≠ 1 且 ≠ 5（4G未注册）
- emm_cause = 0（4G无明确拒绝码）
- 5gmm_cause ≠ 0（5G有拒绝码）

**判断条件**：4G未注册但无EMM拒绝码，5G有拒绝码

**输出结论**：
```
问题原因：5G网络注册被拒绝（拒绝码#[具体值]），且4G也未能正常注册。
建议措施：
措施1：优先排查4G问题
- 将充电桩中的SIM卡插入手机确认当地网络覆盖的信号强度正常；
- 检查天线连接；
- 检查网络模式配置（AUTO）。

措施2：检查SIM卡状态
- 将SIM卡插入手机，验证能否正常注册4G网络；
- 联系SIM卡提供商确认业务状态，流量充足且无欠费。

措施3：检查APN配置
- 确认APN配置正确。

措施4：如以上均无效
- 使充电桩连接手机热点，进行问题反馈并执行云端深度分析。
```

---

## 规则优先级说明

规则按以下优先级顺序匹配，命中后立即输出结论：

| 优先级 | 规则 | 说明 |
|--------|------|------|
| 1 | 规则0-1/0-2 | 4G已注册，不是故障 |
| 2 | 规则1-1 ~ 1-14 | EMM拒绝码场景 |
| 3 | 规则2-1 ~ 2-9 | ESM拒绝码场景 |
| 4 | 规则3-1 ~ 3-2 | 无拒绝码+信号问题 |
| 5 | 规则4-1 ~ 4-3 | 无拒绝码+驻留未注册 |
| 6 | 规则5-1 ~ 5-2 | 注册状态异常 |
| 7 | 规则6-1 | 5G拒绝码（4G也失败时） |

#!/bin/sh

PORT="/dev/ttyUSB2"
LOG="$LOG2"   # 统一变量名
LOG2="/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/tem_sim_status.log"   # 存储生成的sim_status.log的原始文件tem_sim_status.log

# === 1. 清空日志目录 ===
echo "sim_status.sh start."

# === 2. 清理残留 cat 进程 ===
killall cat 2>/dev/null
sleep 1
killall -9 cat 2>/dev/null

# === 4. 发送AT诊断命令序列 ===

# ========== AT+CPIN? ==========
echo "AT+CPIN?" > "$LOG2"   # 初始化文件（用 >）
cat "$PORT" >> "$LOG2" &
CAT_PID=$!
sleep 0.2
printf "AT+CPIN?\r" > "$PORT"
sleep 10
kill $CAT_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $CAT_PID 2>/dev/null

# ========== AT+CIMI ==========
echo "AT+CIMI" >> "$LOG2"
cat "$PORT" >> "$LOG2" &
CAT_PID=$!
sleep 0.2
printf "AT+CIMI\r" > "$PORT"
sleep 10
kill $CAT_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $CAT_PID 2>/dev/null

# === 将tem_sim_status.log去除ok、及空格，生成sim_status.log用过大模型分析 ===
echo "[LOG_INFO]:" > "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log"
sed '/^[[:space:]]*OK[[:space:]]*$/d; /^[[:space:]]*$/d' "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/tem_sim_status.log" >> "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log"

# === 将tem_sim_status.log去除ok、及空格，生成sim_status.log用过大模型分析 end===

# === 检查sim_status.log中是否包含READY字段或十位以上连续数字并添加结论 ===
if grep -q "READY" "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log" || grep -qE '[0-9]{10,}' "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log"; then
    echo "[CONCLUSION]:[PASS] SIM card status is normal." >> "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log"
else
    echo "[CONCLUSION]:[FAIL] The SIM card status is abnormal. Please check the status of the SIM card in the SIM card slot." >> "/data/aifile/ailog/cellular/sim_status.log"
fi
# === 结论添加完成 ===

echo "sim_status.sh end."

DH240 charger in Japan failed to establish data connection on SoftBank network. Root cause: APN not configured. Network registration was successful on 5G (mode 11), but PDP Context 1 had empty APN. Error code 209 (QMIWDS_START_NETWORK_INTERFACE_REQ rejected). Solution: Manually set APN to 'softbank' with ContextID 4.

Symptoms: 1) Charger shows network registration OK but no data. 2) AT+COPS returns SoftBank with mode 11 (5G NR). 3) AT+CGDCONT shows empty APN in Context 1. 4) AT+CGACT=1,1 returns PDP authentication failure. 5) Error 209 in QMI logs.

Solution for DH240 Japan SoftBank network issue: 1) Access modem AT interface. 2) Set APN using AT+QICSGP=4,1,"softbank","","",1 or AT+CGDCONT=4,"IP","softbank". 3) Activate PDP context with AT+CGACT=1,4. Japan SoftBank APNs: data='softbank', ims='ims', emergency='sos'.

Root causes for cellular data connection failures on EV chargers: 1) APN Configuration: invalid/erroneous APN names, missing credentials, authentication method mismatch. 2) Network Policy: unopened data services, account arrears, operator blacklist. 3) Protocol Issues: PDP negotiation failure, QoS parameter mismatch. 4) Network Failures: GGSN/PGW overload, core network routing errors.

AT commands for diagnosing cellular network issues on Autel chargers: AT+COPS? (operator query), AT+CIMI (IMSI), AT+CCID (ICCID), AT+CSQ (2G/3G signal), AT+QCSQ (5G signal - Quectel), AT+CGDCONT? (PDP contexts), AT+QICSGP (APN config), AT+CGACT (PDP activation), AT+CFUN? (radio function). Error codes: CME ERROR 3 = operation not allowed, Error 209 = network rejected.

Japan SoftBank APN settings for EV chargers: Data APN: 'softbank', IMS/VoLTE APN: 'ims', Emergency APN: 'sos'. MCC: 440, MNC: 20. Network mode 11 indicates 5G NR registration. IMSI prefix 44020 = SoftBank Japan subscriber.

Standard PDP activation flow: 1) Power on modem, wait for AT OK. 2) Check SIM: AT+CPIN (20s timeout). 3) Check CS registration: AT+CREG? (90s timeout). 4) Check PS registration: AT+CGREG/AT+CEREG (60s). 5) Configure APN: AT+QICSGP. 6) Activate PDP: AT+QIACT (40s timeout). 7) If fail, deactivate: AT+QIDEACT, retry 3 times then restart. 8) Open connection: AT+QIOPEN. 9) Send data: AT+QISEND.

问题描述：持续性短暂离线，同一个场站3台桩，只有一台明显。
Jira: VRC-5603

问题分析：
1. 三台设备注册相同的网络小区，但问题桩被网络分配的DNS网段为10.21网段，而正常的2台桩被核心网分配10.31网段。
2. 核心网对注册的网络设备有detach行为，导致断连。
3. 如果是设备版本问题或服务器问题，3台桩都会出现问题，而非其中一台。
4. 8月12日北京时间问题设备正常，8月13-14日问题桩被核心网切换到10.31网段后运行正常。
5. 从log中getnet的丢包和延迟统计看，离线期间有25%、50%、75%的丢包。

结论：网段配置由核心网根据业务负载动态调整，问题由网络行为导致。

关键事件：
- NW DEACT: 网络强制去激活上下文
- NW DETACH: 网络强制分组域分离（踢掉设备）

2.4. URC说明

TCP/IP AT命令的URC统一以+QIURC:的形式上报Host，涉及数据接收、连接断开和接入等。在URC的前后均有<CR><LF>，本文里均不显示。

2.4.1. +QIURC: "closed" 连接断开通知

当TCP Socket服务连接被远程客户端断开或者因为网络异常导致断开，模块将上报该URC。同时该Socket将处于"Closing"状态（<socket_state>=4），调用AT+QICLOSE=<connectID>后Socket服务可恢复成"Initial"状态。

+QIURC: "closed" 连接断开通知
+QIURC: "closed",<connectID> - Socket服务连接被断开

参数：
<connectID> 整型。Socket连接号。范围：0~11。

2.4.3. +QIURC: "incoming full" 客户端连接已满通知

如果客户端连接已达限额，或者已经没有Socket系统资源可供分配，有新的客户端连接请求时模块会上报URC：+QIURC: "incoming full",<serverID>。

+QIURC: "incoming full" 客户端连接已满通知
+QIURC: "incoming full",<serverID> - 客户端连接请求已满

参数：
<serverID> 整型。接受客户端连接<connectID>的服务器。服务器的<service_type>是"TCP LISTENER"，监听Socket ID是<serverID>。

2.4.5. +QIURC: "pdpdeact" PDP去激活通知

PDP可以被网络去激活。PDP被去激活以后，模块会上报该URC通知Host。Host需执行AT+QIDEACT去激活上下文ID并重置所有连接。

+QIURC: "pdpdeact" PDP去激活通知
+QIURC: "pdpdeact",<contextID> - <contextID>PDP上下文ID被去激活

这是网络主动断开设备连接的关键指标！

问题现象：4G频繁掉线，OCPP连接不稳定，不定时掉线十几秒至几十秒。模组上报pdp去激活事件：QIURC: pdpdeact。

地点：土耳其
运营商：欧洲多个运营商
问题产品型号：AE22（AE0022G1GR7C002590）
问题单号：EVSHWT-1276

问题根因：根据QIURC定义，只有网络主动断开设备与网络的连接时，模组才会上报QIURC: pdpdeact。部分欧洲运营商会主动断开长连接低速网络产品以防止网络拥塞。

解决方法：模组可在十秒内恢复在线，此问题不会在所有运营商网络上发生。

[代码参考] ERROR_PATTERNS定义：r'\+QIURC: "pdpdeact"': '网络主动断连'
solution: 模组十秒内可恢复，不影响所有运营商
cause: 欧洲运营商主动断开长连接低速网络产品防止网络拥塞

text:
# 错误模式识别
ERROR_PATTERNS = {
    r'CME ERROR: 50': 'PDP激活失败',
    r'\+QIURC: "pdpdeact"': '网络主动断连',
}

这是AT命令错误代码的模式匹配定义：
- CME ERROR: 50 表示PDP激活失败
- +QIURC: "pdpdeact" 表示网络主动断开连接

解决方法：更换SIM卡或进行对比测试。

问题现象：4G设备离线。

问题现象：DH240在日本使用KDDI SIM卡拨号失败。

地点：日本
运营商：KDDI
问题产品型号：DH240
问题单号：NA

问题根因：KDDI SIM卡的APN中包含用户名和密码，使用AT+CGDCONT设置APN时无法进行拨号认证。

解决方法：将APN设置方法从AT+CGDCONT改为AT+QICSGP，可以解决拨号认证失败的问题。
cause: KDDI APN需要用户名密码，AT+CGDCONT无法认证

2.5 Usage Environment
The recommended usage environment during the warranty period is as follows:
 Avoid use in marine environments or on land near strong pollution sources, and in environments
with only simple shelter. Otherwise, it may easily lead to product corrosion, water ingress and
other problems, causing equipment failure. The resulting functional abnormalities or component
damage are not covered by the warranty. Pollution sources refer to areas within the following
radius:
— 0.5 kilometers from salt water (e.g. ocean).
— 3 kilometers away from heavy pollution sources such as metallurgy, coal mines, and thermal
power plants.
— 2 kilometers away from medium pollution sources such as chemical industry, rubber,
electroplating and so on.
— 1 kilometer away from light pollution sources such as food, leather, and heating boilers.
 For applications in offshore environments, the equipment shell may be subject to spot corrosion
or the life of the entire machine may be shortened, so you need to choose carefully. Please consult
the relevant service department for details. The offshore range value is an area within the
following radius: 0.5 kilometers to 3.7 kilometers from salt water (such as the ocean).

4.2 Installation Site Design
An installation site design is prerequisite for determining conduit and wiring requirements from the
panel to the proposed parking spaces, as well as for measuring cellular signal strength and identifying
suitable locations for any necessary cellular signal booster equipment.
CAUTION
Always check local codes or consult an engineer to ensure the site is prepared in
accordance with all applicable regulations. Local authorities might not permit a unit
to operate if it is not installed to code.
DANGER
The EV charging equipment must be kept at a safe distance from any potential
explosive environment.
General installation site design procedure:
1. Select a suitable site. Refer to 4.2.1 Location Requirements and 4.2.2 Space Requirements.
2. Prepare the foundation for the cabinet. Refer to 4.2.3 Foundation Requirements.
3. Complete the electrical design. Prepare the cables, including the AC input cable, PE cable,
Earth cable, and Ethernet cable (if no cellular network is available). Ensure that the cable slack
is sufficient to guide the cables into the cabinet. Refer to 4.2.4 Electrical Design.

 Consider locations where it will be easy to add future stations.

possible, avoid or minimize trenching requirements.

panel capacity is sufficient. Identify costs for any necessary upgrades and/or a new dedicated
electrical panel. A certified electrician or project engineer is highly recommended when it comes
to evaluating available capacity and identifying required upgrades.

existing electrical supply.

adequate signal strength.
 Avoid locations under trees where sap, pollen or leaves may fall on the charging station increasing
the station’s maintenance requirements.

accommodating the various charging port locations on different EV’s.

electronic components from being damaged by dust or particles.
3. Use the multimeter to check the resistance between the PE bus bar at the upstream
distribution cabinet and the PE bus bar inside the charging station, and ensure it complies with
IEC60364-4-41. Make sure the correct connection between the PE bus bar at the upstream
distribution cabinet and the PE bus bar inside the charging station.
4. Use the multimeter to check the following voltages, which need to meet the rated voltage
demand of the charging station:
1) Check the input voltage of the upstream breaker.
2) Turn on the upstream breaker, and then check the output voltage of the breaker.
3) Check the voltage of the MCCB in the charging station.
4) Check the voltage of the MCB and RCD in the charging station.
5. Turn on the MCCB and MCB.
